text:
maria-finance: Heads-up — we're launching a centralized subscription review for recurring SaaS spend > $500/mo across teams. Objective: remove duplicate seats, consolidate vendors, and ensure every subscription has an owner. Please action by Fri 2026-04-03.

maria-finance: Action items: 1) Add your subscriptions to the Subscriptions tracking sheet (link below). 2) Use the naming convention `sub-<team>-<vendor>`. 3) Fill owner, renewal date, monthly/annual cost, and criticality. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/subscriptions

alex-cto: Quick Q — are cloud marketplace charges (eg: AWS marketplace) in scope?

maria-finance: Short answer: no for infra-only marketplace charges. If a vendor mixes infra+SaaS, mark as `mixed` and we'll follow up.

jordan-ops: For long-term contracts where legal already owns renewals, do we still assign an operational owner?

maria-finance: Yes — add both: `renewal_owner` (legal/contracts) and `operational_owner` (day-to-day contact). For contracts > $25k/year tag @contracts so Procurement can coordinate.

sophie-peopleops: Some HR/compliance systems can't be moved or consolidated — are we exempting those?

maria-finance: People Ops and compliance-critical tools approved by @sophie-peopleops are exempt from cancellation but please still add them to the sheet for visibility.

maria-finance: Delegated purchase guidance recap: - One-off purchases < $1,000: manager approval OK. - Purchases $1,000–$5,000: notify Procurement, use virtual card when possible. - SaaS renewals > $5k/month or multi-year deals: open procurement and legal review (RFQ + SOW).

alex-cto: If a renewal comes up before the 4/3 deadline, what's the exception path?

maria-finance: Submit a Procurement Exception request (https://redwood.atlassian.example/procure-exceptions) with business justification + impact. Procurement will respond within 48 hours and escalate as needed.

vendor-bot: :bell: Automated reminder created — Subscriptions review due 2026-04-03. Sheet: https://redwood.atlassian.example/subscriptions

ana-engineering: I'll run a quick inventory of our CI/CD plugins tonight and tag owners.

maria-finance: Thanks, Ana. If any team needs help mapping subscriptions, reply here and we'll set a 15m sync. Please use `sub-<team>-<vendor>` naming and add renewal dates — that helps with forecasting. :spiral_calendar: :thumbsup:
